remarks: Great city vibez! Steps to dining, shopping & entertainment, minutes to the I-95, Stamford Metro-North train station express train to NYC's Grand Central & more. Completely updated 3 bedroom, 1 bathroom apartment unit located in an extremely convenient location of downtown Stamford. Newer kitchen appliances. Beautiful hardwood floors. Newer windows. Has in-unit washer & dryer. Rent includes water & hot water. The unit bathes in sunlight creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Won't last! Book a showing today! A must see! Unit is on the 2nd floor. Comes with 2 assigned parking spots in rear of building.
